owner_direction: 2026-10-03, after playing 0.3.78: make the melee weapon ordinary Melee, not true melee, with much flashier effects and homing projectiles. Keep the bone-hook art, the flowing figure eight, the black-blood material, the crimson/red-magic taste (refined, not gaudy), no silk/thread language and nothing on a music clock
design_decisions: Staff Reap stays: every weapon in the set builds and releases; crescent hits engrave the staff, so range play still builds it

the measure keeps its 6.4x: Over/Under blade 4 x 0.6, their crescents 4 x 0.4, Whip blade 1.0, lash arc 0.4, volley 5 x 0.2 (53% blade, 6% lash arc, 41% crescents); full loop 286 raw per tick (Ebon 281), range play 198 (69%)

turning circle (added to the spec): an aim point behind the beam and inside the 75 px circle is held past, then turned back to; without it volley crescents that passed a small target 300 px out orbited it at 75 px for the rest of their life; with it every one of the domain sweep's 1,848 cone throws reaches its still target
the bead sits on the body's apex: ScarletInkCanvas.End takes a bead sample (default the last), so other weapons' paths are unchanged

the crescent body is R 16 (the lash arc's radius; volley R 14) with w 72 x h 26 (volley 54 x 20) and tips at 0.45 R: the material's lips and halo have a fixed anti-aliased width, so at R 9 they filled the whole body and it read as a flat red neon tube (pink-fringed by day); a tuning grid of R 9-16 at ages 3-50 over night and day showed the dark core and filaments between the lips from about R 14, as on the lash arc. The depth grows with R so the arc keeps its concave bite. Draw equals collide, so the hit footprint grew with it (broadphase 60 px)

no ink smear: a residue path behind the crescent (radius R, then 3/4 of the arc) was rendered on night, day and sanctum and read as a grey comet line on bright ground and a pair of faint rim lines on dark ground (thread); the wake is a cinder every 2 ticks across the arc's back instead (an additive ember a tick summed to white on the day sky and read as snow)

drips carry 6% of the crescent's speed, radius 1.7, life 8; hit sprays keep 4-7 px/tick, radius 2.2, life 14; every drop draws as a bead whose tail is at most one radius (drawn over its last 1.5 ticks, gravity stretched a drop into a 15 px red streak: the drips read as red rain and the hit drops as pills)
a hit on a bystander keeps the target; the chain runs after a hit on the target (or with none)

the wanted cues ScytheVolley and CrescentBreak live in ScarletRewardCues.Wanted, outside the 35 shipped, and play StaffCut (the break 6 dB lower) in voice pools of their own name, so a stand-in never takes a Staff Reap cut's voice

the crescent's ends taper to horns (tips 0.15 R, depth 32 / volley 25; was 0.45 R and 26 / 20): at 0.45 R the round ends read as a boomerang; at actual size on night and day the middle keeps the dark core and red lips while the thin horns burn red like a sickle moon. Draw equals collide, so the tip capsules thin with them; the apex and its R 16 are unchanged

review_fixes: replication (major): Throw's initial target and the cap's oldest.Break() were flagged with netUpdate from inside the stroke's update, which Projectile.Update clears before the crescent's own AI (and NewProjectile had already sent the spawn with ai[0] = -1), so peers flew every crescent straight to the 12-tick sync and could miss a cap break; SetTarget and Break now set a resync flag that the crescent's own AI turns into netUpdate (the SableStaff pattern), with a tools wiring check
material (major): bodies R 9/7 read as flat red neon; now R 16/14 with a visible black core (see design decisions)

break residue (major): the spatter stroke (residue curve, radius 6 to 1) and the thin scar read as hairlines/thread; the spatter is now three residue blots (radius 7, 5, 4), the scar is the thicker body's (as thick as the lash arc's approved scar) and lasts 10 ticks instead of 20; it stays on every end, because the close has already dried the body into that scar and dropping it would pop the dried arc out in one frame
drops (major): bead tails capped at one radius, drip life 14 -> 8, hit drop life 20 -> 14

wake (minor): the wake and apex sparks are cinders (a new particle kind drawn through the darkening and additive passes, so it blends crimson over the ground) every 2 ticks instead of an additive ember every tick; by day they read as dark crimson specks instead of white snow
spec (minor): the crescent's owner state lives in its own fields, not localAI; the replication row describes the republish
comment (minor): ScytheVisuals no longer lists the rejected smear
